title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report
abstract: We introduce TabPFN-3.5, our new flagship Tabular Foundation Model. It significantly outperforms its predecessor, TabPFN-3, and all existing baselines across a broad range of tabular problems. TabPFN-3.5 sets a new state of the art on standard tabular prediction in TabArena, and extends it to the data practitioners encounter in practice: non-i.i.d. data with temporal or grouped splits, tables with strings, text and images, high-cardinality categorical features, and wide tables with many features. These gains carry over to our task-specific harnesses: state of the art on relational data and stronger time-series forecasting. For faster inference, our variant TabPFN-3.5-Fast runs up to 3x faster than TabPFN-3 while keeping most of the accuracy gains. In addition, we upgrade TabPFN-3.5-Plus, expanding our multimodal capabilities with advanced text and date handling alongside proprietary inference optimizations. Finally, we release a new version of our Thinking mode, TabPFN-3.5-Thinking, which scales inference-time computation to push the state of the art further. It benefits from our stronger base model and from inference-time improvements that make it up to 12x faster than TabPFN-3-Thinking.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Welcome to Advanced Topics in Machine Learning. Today's lecture is on the paper 'TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report' from the team at Prior Labs. We've seen a surge of interest in tabular foundation models recently, with work like 'TabICLv2' pushing the boundaries of in-context learning for tables. This paper is interesting because it tries to move these models beyond clean, academic datasets into the messier, more practical settings we often see in industry. It's a direct challenge to the long-held dominance of gradient-boosted trees. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 欢迎来到机器学习进阶专题。今天这堂课讲的是Prior Labs团队的论文《TabPFN-3.5：技术报告》。最近大家对表格基础模型的兴趣猛增，像《TabICLv2》这样的工作不断推动表格上下文学习的边界。这篇论文有意思的地方在于，它试图让这些模型走出干净的学术数据集，进入我们在工业界经常见到的那种更杂乱、更实际的场景。这是对梯度提升树长期主导地位的一次直接挑战。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor. You said it challenges gradient-boosted trees. But aren't models like XGBoost and LightGBM still the standard because they're fast, robust, and don't require massive pretraining?
segments.zh: 教授您好。您说它挑战了梯度提升树。但像XGBoost和LightGBM这样的模型不仍然是标准吗？因为它们速度快、稳健，而且不需要大规模的预训练。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: An excellent point. That has been the case for years. The core argument of the tabular foundation model community is that a single, large pretrained model can eventually outperform models that have to be trained from scratch on every new dataset. The goal is to amortize the cost of training over many tasks. TabPFN-3.5 is trying to prove this holds true even on the kinds of data where tree-based models have traditionally excelled.
segments.zh: 说得非常好。这种情况已经持续很多年了。表格基础模型社区的核心论点是，一个单一的、大规模预训练的模型最终能够超越那些每换一个新数据集就得从头训练的模型。目标是把训练成本分摊到许多任务上。TabPFN-3.5 想要证明，即使在树模型传统上占优的那类数据上，这一点依然成立。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The main contribution here is extending the TabPFN approach to a much wider variety of data regimes. The previous generation of these models worked well on standard, independently and identically distributed classification tasks. However, they often fell behind tuned conventional models when dealing with non-i.i.d. data, like temporal or grouped splits, or tables with high-cardinality categorical variables, text, and even images.
segments.zh: 这里的主要贡献在于把 TabPFN 的方法扩展到了更广泛的数据场景。上一代模型在标准的独立同分布分类任务上表现不错，但遇到非独立同分布的数据时，往往就落后于调优过的传统模型了，比如按时间或分组划分的数据，或者包含高基数类别变量、文本甚至图像的表格。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So what does non-i.i.d. mean in this context? Is it like predicting for a new customer segment or a future time period that wasn't in the training data?
segments.zh: 那这里的非独立同分布到底是什么意思呢？是指要预测一个训练数据里没见过的新客户群体，还是预测一个未来的时间段？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Precisely. The model needs to generalize to new groups or time periods not seen during training, which is a common real-world scenario. To tackle this, the authors expanded the synthetic data generation pipeline they use for pretraining. They specifically focused on creating synthetic data that mimics these challenging characteristics: high-cardinality features, wide tables, and grouped structures. The core idea is that if the model sees this kind of structural complexity during pretraining, it will be better equipped to handle it at inference time.
segments.zh: 正是如此。模型需要泛化到训练时没见过的新群体或新时间段，这是现实中很常见的情况。为了解决这个问题，作者扩展了预训练时使用的合成数据生成流程。他们专门聚焦于生成能模拟这些棘手特征的合成数据：高基数特征、宽表以及分组结构。核心思路是，如果模型在预训练阶段见过这类结构复杂性，那它在推理时就能更好地应对。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So it's still using the prior-data fitted network approach, just with a much richer and more diverse 'prior'?
segments.zh: 所以它还是用的先验数据拟合网络那套方法，只是先验更丰富、更多样了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The fundamental mechanism is the same, but the scope is broader. It's also now a single multitask model for both classification and regression, which simplifies deployment, rather than requiring separate checkpoints for each task type.
segments.zh: 没错。基本机制没变，但适用范围更广了。现在它还是一个单一的多任务模型，同时处理分类和回归，这简化了部署，不再需要为每种任务类型单独保存检查点。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Let's get into the technical details, because the improvements aren't just from the data. The model architecture itself was updated. They retained the transformer backbone but made two critical changes to how each cell in the table is represented. First, they introduced 'Fourier value features.' Instead of just a simple linear projection of a cell's value, they transform it using sine and cosine functions with learned frequencies. This creates a richer encoding that can capture fine-grained distinctions, which is especially useful for high-cardinality categorical features that have been encoded as numbers.
segments.zh: 我们来聊聊技术细节，因为这次的提升不光来自数据。模型架构本身也做了更新。他们保留了Transformer主干，但对表格中每个单元格的表示方式做了两个关键改动。第一，他们引入了“傅里叶数值特征”。不再只是对单元格的值做一个简单的线性投影，而是用正弦和余弦函数加上可学习的频率来对它做变换。这样就产生了一种更丰富的编码，能捕捉到更细粒度的差异，对于那些被编码成数字的高基数类别特征尤其有用。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The second is 'in-context empirical cumulative distribution function features.' Essentially, for each value, the model calculates its rank or percentile relative to all other values seen in that same column within the training context. This makes the representation robust to the original scale of the feature and helps mitigate the effects of outliers and skewed distributions.
segments.zh: 第二个是“上下文内的经验累积分布函数特征”。简单来说，对于每个值，模型会计算它在同一列中、训练上下文里所有其他值中的排名或百分位。这样一来，特征的表示就不会受原始尺度的影响，也有助于减轻异常值和偏态分布带来的问题。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: That sounds computationally intensive, especially the ECDF part. And the report says the model is bigger, with about 220 million parameters. How do they manage inference latency for practical applications?
segments.zh: 这听起来计算量很大，尤其是ECDF那部分。报告里还说这个模型更大，大约有2.2亿个参数。那在实际应用中，他们是怎么控制推理延迟的？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's the key operational challenge. They address it with a sophisticated caching mechanism. When you provide the training data, the model processes it once and stores the relevant intermediate tensors—attention keys, values, and the feature distribution states. When a new test row comes in, it can be evaluated against this pre-computed, cached context very quickly. They also use grouped-query attention to keep the cache size manageable. And for different use cases, they offer a 'Fast' checkpoint with fewer parameters and proprietary variants that use techniques like FP8 arithmetic to reduce latency.
segments.zh: 这是实际部署中的关键难题。他们用一个精巧的缓存机制来解决。当你提供训练数据时，模型会先处理一遍，把相关的中间张量存下来——注意力的键、值，还有特征分布状态。等新的测试样本进来，就能很快地拿它跟这份预先算好、缓存好的上下文做评估。他们还用了分组查询注意力来控制缓存大小。针对不同场景，他们还提供了参数更少的“Fast”检查点，以及一些专有版本，用FP8运算之类的技术来降低延迟。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The implications of this work, if the results are reproducible, are significant. The paper reports that TabPFN-3.5 or one of its variants ranks first on all seven benchmark families they evaluated on, including those with relational data, text, and images. This suggests that a single pretrained model can serve as a very strong, general-purpose baseline across an extremely diverse set of tabular tasks, potentially reducing the need for extensive, per-dataset feature engineering and model tuning.
segments.zh: 如果结果可复现，这项工作的意义就很重大。论文报告称，TabPFN-3.5 或其某个变体在他们评估的全部七个基准系列上都排名第一，包括涉及关系型数据、文本和图像的任务。这表明，单个预训练模型可以在极其多样化的表格任务上充当非常强大的通用基线，从而有可能减少对大量按数据集进行的特征工程和模型调优的需求。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hold on, the report also mentions that the top-performing variants, 'Plus' and 'Thinking,' are proprietary and their details aren't disclosed. That seems like a major caveat for reproducibility and for understanding what's actually driving the performance gains. Is the open-source model competitive on its own?
segments.zh: 等一下，报告里还提到表现最好的两个变体，Plus和Thinking，是专有的，细节没有公开。这对可复现性来说是个很大的问题，也让人搞不清楚到底是什么在推动性能提升。那开源模型本身有竞争力吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is an important critique and a limitation you've correctly identified. The open-source TabPFN-3.5 model does show a substantial improvement over TabPFN-3 and is competitive with other top models. However, the absolute state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks do rely on these proprietary components. This is a growing tension in the field, where commercial labs publish results based on methods that aren't fully public. It means that while the paper provides strong evidence for the potential of this approach, independent validation of the peak performance claims is not currently possible.
segments.zh: 这是一个很重要的批评，你也准确地指出了它的局限性。开源的TabPFN-3.5模型确实相比TabPFN-3有大幅提升，也能和其他顶尖模型竞争。不过，在几个基准上达到的绝对最优结果，确实依赖于那些专有组件。这是这个领域里一个日益突出的矛盾——商业实验室发表的结果基于并非完全公开的方法。这意味着，虽然这篇论文为这种方法的潜力提供了强有力的证据，但目前还无法对峰值性能的说法进行独立验证。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: So, to wrap up, the key takeaway from TabPFN-3.5 is the demonstration that tabular foundation models can be extended to effectively handle a much broader range of complex, non-i.i.d. data structures than previously shown. By enriching the input representations and diversifying the synthetic pretraining data, the model establishes itself as a powerful default for many tabular prediction tasks. The work pushes the entire field to consider what problems are truly solvable with a single, generalist model. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 总之，总结一下，TabPFN-3.5 的核心结论是证明了表格基础模型可以被扩展，从而有效处理比以前所展示的更广泛、更复杂的非独立同分布数据结构。通过丰富输入表示并多样化合成预训练数据，该模型确立了自己作为许多表格预测任务强大默认选择的地位。这项工作推动整个领域去思考，哪些问题真正可以用一个单一的通用模型来解决。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以询问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
